evidence_slice: Homes England announced on 16 February 2026 that the former HMP Northeye site in Bexhill had been formally transferred from the Home Office to Homes England under the government's Single Land Programme and that Homes England intends to bring the site forward for housing development with Rother District Council and the local community. Rother District Council's adopted Development and Site Allocations Local Plan identifies Policy BEX10, Land at Northeye, Bexhill, as a housing allocation for 140 dwellings.
